declarations.candidateArtifact: local verified hardened candidate for webgazer-aac.js
declarations.promotionRule: The hardened candidate must not replace the repository runtime unless the promoted bytes reproduce the declared SHA-256/Git blob identity.

details.intent: Verify authority, evidence, privacy, reversibility and bounded-resource invariants before real browser/webcam/AAC-board testing.
nonClaims: No claim that DDC providers executed unless a DDC Run records that execution
No claim that the repository root runtime already contains the locally verified hardening candidate

successCriteria: DDC authority and evidence invariants remain green
Persisted calibration excludes raw eye material
No runtime network primitive is introduced
Install and video-frame interception are reversible
Full calibration clearing removes persistent and in-memory calibration evidence
Polynomial, RBF, calibration and evidence-lineage retention remain within declared bounds
Gaze runtime does not directly invoke target click authority
Promotion is rejected when candidate identity cannot be preserved exactly

epistemicIntegrity.methodology: Reproduction against machine-readable transition invariants with explicit observed/declared/inferred separation and fail-closed authority assumptions.

authorityWarnings: A green pre-hardware gate does not authorize real AAC activation or replace human/browser/webcam validation.
Observed runtime behavior may inform evidence but may not silently broaden action authority.
The hardened candidate is not repository-promoted until artifact identity is verified after publication.
